Privacy Commitment

PRIVACY POLICY

Effective Date: November 2024 • Version 1.0

1. Zero Telemetry & Surveillance

Applications distributed by Xtremerpie (including Xtreme AI Browser, Awaken, and future desktop releases) are engineered with an uncompromising privacy foundation: Zero Telemetry. We do not track, log, aggregate, or sell your keystrokes, browsing history, alert schedules, or hardware identifiers.

2. Local-First Data Storage

All configurations, custom media files, profile states, and cache directories created by our applications remain exclusively on your local machine in designated user application data folders (e.g., %APPDATA% on Windows). You retain 100% control over this data and can wipe or inspect it at any time.

3. AI and Model Processing

When utilizing AI features (such as Rafail AI within Xtreme AI Browser):

  • In local model mode (GGUF / Ollama), inference runs 100% offline on your device with zero network packets emitted.
  • In remote API mode, only the exact text prompt or page fragment you actively submit is processed by your configured provider, adhering to their API data retention terms.

4. Website & App Hub Analytics

This website (Xtremerpie App Hub) uses no third-party tracking cookies or marketing surveillance pixels. Download links to Google Drive are direct file distribution links governed by standard Google Drive infrastructure.

Questions regarding our privacy principles can be sent to contact@xtremerpie.dev.
